evidence: Changes net_processing.cpp and blockencodings to pass deserialization parameters and drop malformed peer messages early.
rationale: Mitigates a peer-triggered memory exhaustion DoS attack by rejecting un-validatable transactions and blocks early in message deserialization. According to commit 82cd7e7427, this prevents a peer from making the node allocate memory for ~400,000 empty CTransaction objects in a single 4 MB block message or triggering repeated multi-megabyte vector reallocations.
